training.augmentation: one random dihedral transform per image

setup: Round 2: tumor examples from slides 28 and 29 (round 1: 99% slide 28) plus random flips/rotations; prompt v2, 224 px, thinking off. Inference ran 4 rotations per tile; the dev set (1,000 held-out slide-29 tiles) chose the single (unrotated) view and cutoff 0.778, applied once to test.
gpu_rate_note: wall_s/GPU minutes are for the 4-view test run (24,000 calls); a single-view run would take about a quarter (~1.2 min). gpu_minutes is set to that single-view equivalent. Whole deployment: 12.5 min, ~$2.08 at the same high rate.
